message: Unprivileged overlay mounts need Linux 5.11 or later, so files cannot be layered into the game directory.
Unprivileged user namespaces are disabled, so files cannot be layered into the game directory. Enable them (sysctl kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=1, or the AppArmor policy on Ubuntu).
gamescope is not installed or not on PATH. Install it with your package manager, or choose the normal display.
This gamescope build has no --hdr-enabled flag; the game runs in SDR.
This GPU driver offers Vulkan older than 1.3. DXVK 2.0 and later, which Proton and Veneer use for DirectX 8 to 11, need Vulkan 1.3, so Windows games will not start. Update the GPU driver.
Mesa is older than 22.0. VKD3D-Proton, which runs DirectX 12 games, needs Mesa 22.0 or later on AMD. Update Mesa.
The NVIDIA driver is older than the 535 series. VKD3D-Proton, which runs DirectX 12 games, needs 535 or later. Update the driver.
OptiScaler's FSR 4 output officially runs only on AMD RDNA 3 and RDNA 4 graphics cards. On this GPU, pick XeSS or FSR 3 in OptiScaler's menu (Insert), or DLSS on NVIDIA.
No Vulkan driver answered. Proton translates DirectX to Vulkan, so Windows games will not start. Install your GPU's Vulkan driver (vulkan-radeon, vulkan-intel or nvidia-utils on Arch).
